ai.title: Alibaba quarterly profit drops 75% as AI investment spending grows
ai.description: China's Alibaba reports a 75% drop in profit for the latest quarter from the year before to roughly $1.6 billion as it invests heavily in AI infrastructure. Despite this, revenue from its AI cloud and compute services segment has grown by 45%, and overall revenue has increased 9%. Alibaba started out in e-commerce and online retail, and in recent years increasingly shifted to focusing on AI technologies. It says during the quarter, capital expenditures including AI investments have increased 75% as it races to meet customers demand. CEO Eddie Wu adds at an earnings conference that he believes Alibaba's AI-related revenue growth will accelerate in the coming quarters. Alibaba's U.S.-traded shares are down over 3% following the earnings announcement.
